summary: The diff implements comprehensive responsive design changes across all major components (Header, HeroSection, ServicesSection, AboutSection, ProcessSection, TestimonialsSection, ContactSection, Footer, AnimationWrapper, App.tsx, index.css). The implementation covers nearly all requirements. One notable gap is the HeroSection parallax not being explicitly disabled on mobile at the component level. The ServicesSection grid appears to use 1/2/3/4 columns per the file summary rather than strictly 1/2/3 as specified. Otherwise all major requirements appear addressed.

missing_requirements.requirement: Parallax effect is disabled on mobile (useParallax hook or a media-query guard) to avoid layout issues
missing_requirements.reason: HeroSection.tsx uses useParallax unconditionally and applies parallaxY directly to the background div without a component-level mobile guard, unlike AboutSection which explicitly checks isMobile before applying parallaxY. The hook may handle this internally but the component diff shows no explicit mobile guard in HeroSection.

hallucinated_features.description: ServicesSection grid uses 4 columns on larger screens in addition to 1/2/3 columns
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request specifies only 1 column mobile, 2 columns tablet, 3 columns desktop. The file summary for ServicesSection.tsx explicitly states 'responsive 1/2/3/4 column layout', indicating a 4-column breakpoint was added that was not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: OG meta tags added to index.html
hallucinated_features.reason: The file summary mentions 'added OG tags' to index.html. This was not requested in any of the responsive design requirements REQ-34 through REQ-42.

hallucinated_features.description: Caffeine.ai attribution link with UTM parameters added to Footer
hallucinated_features.reason: The Footer.tsx includes a caffeine.ai attribution link with UTM parameters. This was not part of any requirement in the build request.
